name: components_g4_pumpmap
source:
// PumpMap: head-curve pump, dP = rho*g*map$(Q). Water-like density; the
// head map droops 25 m -> 15 m over 0..0.02 m^3/s, Q = 0.01 gives 20 m.
TABLE hmap(q)
  0      25
  0.02   15
END

PumpMap PM(w1, w2, rho = 998, map$ = hmap)

w1.P    = 150000
w1.mdot = 9.98
dp_pump = w2.P - w1.P
m_out   = w2.mdot
